title: Satisfiable fan-in-two circuits
statement: The set consists of all pairs $(n,C)$, where $n$ is a natural number and $C$ is a directed acyclic Boolean circuit on $n$ inputs, such that every gate of $C$ has at most two incoming arguments and some assignment to the inputs makes its output true.
hypotheses_covered: The pair has a natural-number input size $n$ and a circuit $C$ on $n$ inputs
Every gate has at most two incoming arguments
There exists an input assignment for which the output is true
